route_safety_analysis._comment: Analytic lower-bound speed with full adverse current magnitude; no steering loss, waves, encounter delay, regeneration or food included. Validate with real bodies. Surface polyline conservatively includes wading ends.
route_safety_analysis._comment_final: All five compatible mounts at Swimming0 and10. Survival is not comfortable reserve: Cannonback and Riverdrake remain near exhaustion at level0 and need earned skill/preparation or route tuning. No steering-loss or runtime safety claim.

swim_lesson._comment: Accessible northeast training inlet beside realm arrival, independent of departure dock.60m segment has1.4..2.250m analytic depth; dry shore lies4..6.43m radially inland. It is outside outbound current strips. Real body depth threshold, no mandatory combat, shoreline approaches and current-free placement require runtime verification.
swim_lesson.completion_contract: Enter west marker by normal movement, traverse at least50m in actual swimming mode, reach east marker, then exit at its dry safe landing. Host validates actor realm and active lesson progress through existing movement authority; briefing and teleport do not complete it.

validation._comment: Host observes course progress from owned movement. Reject teleport-sized samples; require at least50m swimming and final dry arrival within8m of the end marker.

terrain._comment: Separate aligned bake bounds pad authored world bounds without moving islands. Sparse island+shore regions avoid a giant empty seabed bake.
terrain.collision_comment: FULL_GAME on sparse island regions; measure memory/startup and two separated remote bodies. One averaged camera is insufficient.

height_formula._comment: Deterministic analytic base surface, highest finite island contribution. Trail grading later requires explicit modifier; not implied here.
height_formula.angular_profile: For each landing sector angular distance d: w=1-smoothstep(half_width_deg,half_width_deg+feather_deg,d). Choose maximum weight and lerp default beach width and inner height toward its profile.
height_formula.noise: Disabled until a shoreline-preserving mask exists. Future detail must be zero at shore and safe anchors.
height_formula.ocean: When r>R: h=-min(seabed_depth,(r-R)*outer_shore_slope). Beyond sparse regions, depth queries return deep sea; no synthetic walkable floor.
height_formula.shore: r=R gives h=0 exactly. Straight crossing gap=center_distance-R_from-R_to.

terrain.region_selection: Only regions intersecting island radius plus shore_apron_m; water gaps do not require terrain collision.

scatter._comment: Water scatter config is future implementation. Meadows fingerprint is insufficient. Exclude landing/approach clear radii.

trail_grading._comment: Starting 6m walk surface, 15m graded shoulders, spatial 32m lookup. Preserve outer 22m coast and all safe shore anchors; blend inland over 10m. Grade targets require baked real-body walks.

unresolved_evidence.detail: Raw planning polylines exceed 8km, but include ungraded steep slopes and unverified meaningful-route geometry. Target applies only to unique baked walked routes; do not claim it from this data count.
unresolved_evidence.issue: Land path target is not proved

unresolved_evidence.detail: Reedhaven to Gull Rest is about155.66m radial shore gap. Explicit prepared-human or mounted optional branch; never required for Shellwatch progression. Do not call it level0-safe.
unresolved_evidence.issue: Gull Rest optional crossing exceeds level0 human endurance

unresolved_evidence.detail: All coast sectors and ramps must be tested for bypass. Current coefficients and flags alone cannot prove controlled departure.
Radial slope/analytic landmarks do not guarantee walkable approach; add shoreline-preserving trail grading and test continuous body movement.
unresolved_evidence.issue: Veilfall radial mountain needs graded hike

unresolved_evidence.detail: Entry spends realm_key_water through existing transition seam; predecessor anchor id must be read from actual merged handoff.
unresolved_evidence.issue: Stormwood anchor ids pending merged dependency

unresolved_evidence.detail: Build and test two separated island bodies with FULL_GAME collision, PCK data inclusion, actual loading/memory and rendered horizon.
unresolved_evidence.issue: Sparse terrain data and full collision budget

veilfall_identity._comment: Owner board mountain identity. The exposed landmark is terrain/cascade, never a sea-visible castle. Interior positions are reserved separately from the heightfield.

first_shore_sightline._comment: Straight analytic sightline is specified, not visibility proof. Camera fog/LOD, intervening terrain and render must verify it.

veilfall_identity.hike_contract: Author graded switchbacks from safe arrival to the waterfall gate at139.396m, matching waterfall_gate_height_m. Existing radial slope is too steep to assume walkable. Do not solve using teleport or surface snapping.

water_routes._comment: Actual shore-to-shore polyline; conservative against later wading threshold. No dock lengths or extra distance invented. Return-current help is not used for outbound safety.
water_routes.safe_channel_combat_policy: No mandatory interception on lesson crossing.
